journal_lines: Tracked quarry into the tunnels. The miner knew the passages. The hunter knew when to wait.
Prey went underground. Followed. The dark was less of a problem with two sets of instincts.
Cave hunt. The miner lit the way. The hunter finished it.
Followed scent into stone. The stone yielded a little. The scent yielded more.
A creature that did not expect to be hunted in its own dark. Surprised it.
Took the prey. Took some ore on the way back through. Good arithmetic.
The mine became a corridor for the chase. The chase became a survey of the mine.
Closed off one passage with rubble. Drove the prey into the other. Both jobs at once.
